# Ziyarath

> A modern Islamic heritage discovery platform — mosques, dargahs, scholars, and sacred places of Kerala, India and the world.

Ziyarath curates researched articles, place profiles, and uroos (annual commemoration) records to help visitors explore Islamic heritage across the Malabar coast and beyond.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Ziyarath and featured heritage places.
- [About](/about): The mission and story behind Ziyarath.
- [Maqams](/maqam): Directory of dargahs and maqams with details, location and history.
- [Uroos](/uroos): Hijri-calendar listing of uroos days and associated scholars.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on Islamic history, sacred places and heritage.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Ziyarath team.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
